## Summary

What changed and why?

## Evidence

What observation, test, or reproducible case supports the change?

## Safety / scope check

- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints/IPs, customer data, or production captures are included.
- [ ] The change does not invent root cause when evidence is insufficient.
- [ ] Public/private implementation boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Local tests and repository hygiene checks pass.
